linkedPullRequests.title: [memory-checker] Refactor the test_memory_checker test
linkedPullRequests.author: Staphylo
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR

The initial goal of this effort was to make this test more reliable on systems with low RAM (4GB).
After making some strides it became clear that some other places in this test needed enhancements.
Such as making the test run faster and removing the external dependency on the `stress` utility.

This refactor in the end introduces many changes:
 - Better reliability on systems with small RAM capacity
 - Better control over the amount of memory consumed by the test
 - Remove the external dependency on the `stress` utility
 - Faster overall runtime for the test
 - A new test case making sure that monit recovers if memory was above threshold for only a single cycle
 - Remove test case checking new/old syntax. It makes no sense to change the product code and then test that, that's not shipping code anyways.

Summary:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/8642

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012
- [x] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Allow this test to pass reliably on memory constrained systems.

#### How did you verify/test it?

This test was run multiple times on a dut with 4GB of RAM using a T1 topology.
But technically this test only requires the `telemetry` container as this it's just verifying some container checks.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?

No change in the affected testbed topologies
